survey-issue-refresh-try-again: Something is wrong, please refresh and try again.
surveys-after-this-question-hint: For any answer to this question.
surveys-other-answers-hint: For the answers without their own arrow in the choices table.
surveys-end-yes-default: Based on your answers, you are eligible. Our team will confirm your eligibility.
surveys-end-no-default: Based on your answers, you are not eligible.
surveys-end-warn-default: Your file needs to be checked. Contact us before you continue.
surveys-result-message-placeholder: Message if the arrow ends the form (optional)
surveys-manages-eligibility-hint: Each answer can lead to a later question or end the form: Eligible, Not eligible or To be checked. The arrows then decide which questions show, in place of display conditions.
surveys-form-ends-hint: Message shown when an arrow ends the form. Going through every question leads to "Eligible". "To be checked" stops the person from going on.
surveys-checks-no-question: Add a first question to see what the arrows leave out.
surveys-check-never-asked: :q is never asked: no answer leads to it.
surveys-check-no-yes: Nobody can reach "Eligible": no answer leads to it.
